newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's NUM says 151,900 miners on strike.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's NUM says 151,900 miners on strike.

text.p: South Africa's National Union of Mineworkers said on Monday numbers so far indicated 151,900 miners were on strike, honouring the country's biggest labour federation's call for a one-day nationwide work stoppage.
The Congress of South African Trade Unions earlier said it estimated 102,000 miners were on strike out of a total workforce in the mines of around 500,000.
Mining houses reported a mixed impact from the action on production of precious metals.
Gold mines reported a varying response to the strike call with some shifts halted completely but many mines still working, if with above-average absenteeism.

The main platinum mines continued to operate, although Anglo American Platinum Corp Ltd said production at its smaller mines of Lebowa Platinum Mines Ltd and Potgietersrust Platinums Ltd had been hit.
